params.prompt:
Repaint this blockout video as a finished hand-painted gouache animation. WIDESCREEN 16:9 landscape frame, frame for frame: keep the exact camera move, framing, timing and every pose from the source video, and paint only what each source frame shows, adding no other characters or objects.

Character: every flame-shaped figure in this video is Sol, exactly the mascot in the reference images (the turnaround sheet shows his shape from every side; the strip of faces shows every eye shape used in this shot). Round, plump gumdrop body with a red outer layer, an orange middle layer and a broad cream inner flame for the face. At rest the face is plain smooth cream with exactly two small tall navy #1C2447 oval eyes set low and close together, solid dark with no whites or highlights, and nothing else on it: nothing is drawn above the eyes and nothing below them. Eyes change ONLY as the beats below say; copy each figure's eyes from each source frame exactly, the same shape, size and place. Short stubby rounded red-orange arm nubs and two tiny blunt stubby red feet; arm nubs stay the same short length in every frame and never stretch or grow. No figure gives off sparks, particles or smoke. Each figure's layers and face move together as one body with a small soft wobble that settles. Every figure keeps the same size and the same place in the frame as in the source video; paint exactly as many figures as each source frame shows, never more and never fewer. The small floating marks near a figure (dots, a light bulb, a question mark, an exclamation mark, sleep marks, a star, music notes, drops, a little puff, flowers) appear ONLY in the frames where the source video shows them, in the same place and size, and vanish when the source stops showing them.

Scene: a wide sandy beach at sunset, the same beach as in the painted reference. Pale warm sand with soft ripples, a calm teal sea along the back with thin white foam lines, a peach and soft orange sky with one low pale yellow sun and a few long soft clouds, and one tiny white sailboat far out on the water. Warm low golden light with soft long shadows, so the beach has depth and glow. A few small pink and lilac shells lie on the sand where the source shows them. The sandcastle is only begun: ONE finished round sand tower with a toothed top and one small dark window, a short piece of sand wall beside it, and one low rounded heap of sand. It is the same in every frame and never changes or grows. One teal beach umbrella on a white pole stands in the sand, and one yellow beach towel with two white stripes lies under it. One blue beach ball with a white band rests on the sand behind. They never move. OUR SOL is the plain one, wearing nothing. RING SOL is the figure wearing one plain pink inflatable swim ring around his middle; the ring is the same in every frame and never comes off. HAT SOL is the figure wearing one small straw hat with a coral band on the tip of his flame; the hat is the same in every frame and never comes off. SLEEPY SOL is the third teammate; he wears nothing. 

Beats: 1. The shot opens close on our Sol, turned a little to the right, leaning that way with the nub on that side raised. His eyes are two navy half-rings with white centres, each cut flat across its top and slanted down toward the middle of his face and the top of his flame is a deeper red, exactly as much as the source shows, from the first frame. 2. CAMERA MOVE: from 0.9 to 1.25 seconds the camera whips quickly to the right, to his three teammates, and holds on them until 2.75 seconds, exactly as in the source video. 3. The three teammates: at the left RING SOL faces the camera, rocking gently from side to side in his pink swim ring, his eyes two small navy curved lines, like gently closed eyes. In the middle HAT SOL stands with his BACK to the camera, looking out at the sea: we see only his plain red-orange back and his straw hat. At the right SLEEPY SOL stands on the yellow towel under the teal umbrella, leaning, his eyes two small navy curved lines, like gently closed eyes, with small navy sleep marks floating above him. None of the three moves from his place. 4. CAMERA MOVE: from 2.75 to 3.1 seconds the camera whips back to our Sol and then pushes in very slowly. 5. Our Sol now faces the camera squarely and stands perfectly still. The red is gone: he is his normal orange and red from here to the last frame. His eyes are two navy half-ovals, flat across the top and rounded below, like half-shut eyes, looking straight at the camera. 6. At 4.4 seconds his eyes become two navy half-rings with white centres, each cut flat across its top and slanted down toward the middle of his face (his flame stays normal orange and red); he stretches up tall, raises both nubs a little and tilts back to look up. He holds that to the last frame. GROUND RULE: every figure's feet rest on the sand and its shadow lies under its feet; after a hop it lands back on the sand. ARM RULE: arm nubs stay the same short stubs in every frame; nobody reaches for or holds anything. 

Style: the painted reference image is this film's own key art: the same beach at sunset, the same sandcastle, the same Sol. Match its soft gouache paint treatment, its warm peach and cream colours, its light and its Sol. Do not copy its camera angle or layout; take every object's place and every pose from the source video. Soft matte gouache painting with visible brushwork, broad simplified shapes, layered colour, softened painted edges and subtle paper texture on the Sols, the props and the beach alike. Forms defined by light and colour. No ink outlines, no black linework, not glossy 3D, not vector art. Smooth natural motion, no motion blur, stable background paint texture. No text, no letters, no numbers, no captions anywhere in the picture, no speech, no music.
